author: TMRX
description: Configure a product from the Price List catalog, generate a customer quote, push parts to a Work Order, or start a Rental.
versionDescription: Major Rental tab rebuild — the recovered v3.11.1 base was missing far more than the rate calculation (v3.26.10). Fixed a real correctness bug: the 'Rental Fee for Desired Time Length' field expects the TOTAL fee for the period, not a per-week rate — this app was pushing the raw rate, which would have under-reported revenue in Hailer on every rental created since the restore. Added the fields that already existed on the Rentals workflow but were never wired into the app: Freight Delivery, Cleaning and Calibration (with a waive option), and the Shipping Responsibility block (Delivery Freight / Return Freight / Insurance During Transportation / Applicable Delivery Terms). Removed 'Deposit' — never a real field on the Rentals workflow, a leftover from an early prototype. Rebuilt the on-screen preview and downloaded PDF from a generic flat table into the real sectioned 'Rental Contract' format (Rental Fee / Setup and Training / Freight Delivery / Freight Return / Cleaning and Calibration, plus a Shipping Responsibility footer), and fixed the same header wrap/overlap bug the main Quote PDF had (v3.26.7). Verified by reproducing an exact prior real test rental (Adidas AG) end-to-end before publishing — every line item and the final total matched precisely.
